Hi there! Shopping for your cat? 🐱 Let us help you find the right fit to match their energy.
Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
Yes—an address change may be possible, but it is not guaranteed because orders are packaged quickly.
What One Fast Cat states:
- The shipping address can be updated until the shipping label has been created.
- After a label is created, the change is handled by UPS or FedEx.
- Carrier address corrections after label creation require a $17 fee.
- Once the package is out for delivery, the address can no longer be changed.
- If you only need to fix something like a misspelling or missing apartment number after shipment, you can ask the carrier to hold the package for pickup instead.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No. Once an order is placed, the items on it can’t be modified, including adding products, removing products, or changing color or quantity.
If your order hasn’t shipped yet, One Fast Cat may be able to cancel it so you can place a new order with the item you want to add. They state cancellations are not guaranteed because orders are processed quickly.
Policy page: Order Changes & Shipping Address Changes
